# Baig Solution

Baig Solution is an AI automation agency headquartered in New Jersey (NJ, USA). We help small and mid-sized businesses automate operations, scale lead follow-up, coordinate CRM systems, and build custom AI support agents.

## Core Services

- **Autonomous AI Agents** (https://baigsolution.com/ai-agents): Deploy custom AI assistants trained on internal PDFs/docs to handle customer support, pre-screen leads, and schedule calendar appointments 24/7.
- **AI Automations** (https://baigsolution.com/ai-automations): Build end-to-end API integrations and workflow automation systems using n8n, Make, and GoHighLevel.
- **Web & App Development** (https://baigsolution.com/website-development): High-performance, lightweight web applications and custom single-page apps optimized for page speed and conversion.
- **Product Shoot** (https://baigsolution.com/product-shoot): Commercial product photography and studio shoots for e-commerce visuals.
